name: Cyient Ltd

ledger.quote: The acquisition is expected to be EPS accretive from year two, but will be EBIT accretive right from year one, which will be our FY27.
ledger.speaker: Krishna Bodanapu
ledger.target: EBIT accretive in FY27, EPS accretive from year two
ledger.verdict: FY27 EBIT accretive target for Kinetic acquisition remains pending during full year execution.

ledger.quote: In the long term, in the medium term, we expect ASIC turnkey to be above 50% of the revenue mix.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.target: ASIC turnkey above 50% of revenue mix
ledger.verdict: Medium term target of over 50% ASIC turnkey mix remains pending.

ledger.quote: At the end of FY27, the revenue mix should be that the ASSP business, which is the third business, the custom product IP business, thanks to Kinetic will be almost 50% of our business, or 50% to 55%.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.verdict: Target of 50-55% ASSP revenue mix by end of FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: We stick to our commitment of delivering flat EBIT for organic business by the end of next year. That's the goal we are working towards.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.verdict: Flat EBIT target for organic business by end of FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: we are looking at somewhere around 15%-20% growth consistently year-over-year from that particular business alone.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.verdict: Consistent 15-20% YoY growth target for custom product business remains pending.

ledger.quote: In this sort of business, mid 45% to 50% margin is definitely possible. And that's where I think we will end up next year as well for this business.
ledger.speaker: Suman Narayan
ledger.verdict: Target of 45-50% gross margin by FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: Looking ahead, our markers remain unchanged from the last quarter, which is consistent revenue growth over the next 4 quarters, integrating Kinetic Technologies, an ASIC pipeline of over $100 million by Q4 and becoming EBIT neutral in FY27.
ledger.speaker: Krishna Bodanapu
ledger.verdict: EBIT neutral target for FY27 remains pending during current fiscal year.

ledger.quote: We expect the Kinetic transaction to close in March or April, and then the integration will start.
ledger.speaker: Krishna Bodanapu
ledger.target: Close Kinetic transaction in March or April
ledger.verdict: Kinetic acquisition was completed and consolidated in Q1 FY27.
ledger.evidence: Q1 was the first quarter where we operated this recently acquired business, fully consolidated it, and the combined revenue of Cyient and the Kinetic Technologies business is $17.9 million.

ledger.quote: And for the EBIT part, we had talked about Q4 of FY 2027 with our current business mix that we have is what our target is.
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.target: 15% EBIT for current business by Q4 FY27
ledger.verdict: Achievement of 15% margin targets by Q4 FY27 was pushed out to FY28.
ledger.evidence: We are still working towards a 15% EBIT, but we now believe that this may take a little longer than the Q4 FY27 we originally aimed for.

ledger.quote: This program will be executed over the next 2 years.
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.target: Execute asset management program over 2 years
ledger.verdict: Two-year asset management execution timeline remains pending.

ledger.quote: And our stated aspiration is to be an industry-leading growth player, which we are working towards.
ledger.speaker: Krishna Bodanapu
ledger.verdict: Aspiration to be an industry-leading growth player remains pending.

ledger.quote: So on FY27, as I've mentioned before, we will continue that commentary, which is we are aspiring for mid- to high single-digit organic growth year-over-year.
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.target: mid- to high single-digit organic growth
ledger.verdict: FY27 mid to high single digit organic growth target remains pending despite Q1 constant currency drop.

ledger.quote: On a normalized basis, we expect the tax rate to be in the range of 27% to 27.5%.
ledger.speaker: Shrinivas Kulkarni
ledger.verdict: Normalized tax rate target of 27-27.5% remains pending with full-year expected rate of 27-28%.

ledger.quote: So we are still sticking to the product life cycle. Does that answer your question?
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Focus on product life cycle model remains pending as strategy unfolds.

ledger.quote: So we do expect that conversion itself will create significant momentum for year 2, year 3 in terms of synergy of cross-sell and upsell into our accounts.
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.target: cross-sell and upsell momentum in year 2 and year 3
ledger.verdict: Synergy cross-sell momentum targeted for year 2 and 3 remains pending.

ledger.quote: So data collection is a massive opportunity with a very limited runway for next 2 to 3 years.
ledger.speaker: Harjott Atrii
ledger.verdict: Data collection opportunity capture over next 2-3 years remains pending.

open.quote: We are working on initiatives to bring this down and we expect the full year run rate of ETR to be between 27% and 28%.
open.speaker: Shrinivas Kulkarni

open.quote: our overall attempt should be to narrow the gap, if not make it flat for this particular quarter. That is what we are working towards.
open.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee

open.quote: So our overall attempt should be to narrow the gap, if not make it flat for this particular quarter. That is what we are working towards.
open.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee

open.quote: We are confident that this will start showing market comparable results in the next two, three quarters.
open.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee

read: Management closed the Kinetic transaction as scheduled but pushed out its 15% EBIT margin timeline from Q4 FY27 into FY28. Too few commitments have matured so far to assess management reliability, with key FY27 growth and margin targets falling due next.
questions: When will DET organic revenue growth return to positive constant currency territory during FY27?
What specific cost levers will bridge the margin gap to reach 15% EBIT in FY28?
How will management reverse the 8.2% sequential decline in the strategic units segment?
bull: Group revenue grew 21.3% YoY to Rs 2076 crore in Q1 FY27 after Kinetic consolidation.
Transportation and mobility segment delivered 14.8% YoY growth in constant currency for Q1 FY27.
Kinetic transaction closed on schedule and contributed $10.4 million revenue in Q1 FY27.
bear: Management delayed its 15% EBIT margin exit target from Q4 FY27 into FY28.
DET constant currency revenue declined 0.9% YoY in Q1 FY27 due to energy softness.
Group PAT fell to Rs 104 crore on a reported basis in Q1 FY27.
